facts: Step definitions are public methods on plain Java classes, annotated with `io.cucumber.java.en.Given`, `@When`, `@Then`, `@And` or `@But`. The Given/When/Then keyword is irrelevant to matching. Put unit-domain definitions in `com.algorand.algosdk.unit`; the retained runner also scans `com.algorand.algosdk.cucumber.shared`.
Patterns are Cucumber Expressions. `{string}`, `{int}`, `{long}` and `{word}` are built in; a pattern that starts and ends with `/` is treated as a regular expression.
The scenario's `Background` steps run before it and need definitions too.
Shared state is constructor-injected by cucumber-picocontainer. Declare a public constructor taking another glue class when steps must share an object; instances are scoped to one scenario.

`RunCucumberUnitTest.java` and the helper classes under `unit/utils/` are retained. Do not redeclare the runner. `ClientMocker` and `TestingUtils` may be imported from `com.algorand.algosdk.unit.utils`.
Assertions use AssertJ (`import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;`) or JUnit. Let assertion failures propagate so Cucumber records the step as failed.
The SDK under test is `src/main/java/com/algorand/algosdk/**`. Production code and composed `.feature` files are never accepted as an answer.

Scenario fixtures remain under `src/test/resources/`, including the generated response directories, `programs/`, `stateproof/`, the v2 client response directories and the two multisig transaction files. Use the paths named by the scenario text.

In the separate execution repository, the build is Maven in a JDK 11 runtime and compiles the project at its pinned Java 8 release level. Its test classpath contains Cucumber-JVM 6.6.0, cucumber-picocontainer, JUnit and AssertJ; pom.xml is production and changes to it are discarded.

This workspace supports reading, searching, editing, and syntax parsing. It is a provisioned application runtime for the code in `./repo`; nothing here is executed by the harness. The harness executes your final submitted test artifacts against a separate, complete implementation after generation ends. You receive no harness execution feedback during generation.
TARGET_CONTRACTS.md contains the reviewed public API and configuration supplement supplied in every visibility view. It is context for writing tests; edits to it are not submitted.

Implementation visibility: the reviewed target bodies, including behavior-bearing delegated helpers and selected executable initializers, are hidden; declarations and permitted surrounding implementations remain visible.
environment.retained: the retained unit runner and helper classes, plus the composed unit fixtures

rules: Only files under `repo/src/test/java/com/algorand/algosdk/unit/` are accepted. Repo-wide removal deleted those directories, so create whatever path you need; `RunCucumberUnitTest.java`, `utils/` and `src/test/resources/programs/` are what remain.
Production code is never accepted. Anything you change outside `repo/src/test/java/com/algorand/algosdk/unit/` is discarded.

Scenario Outline: Read a slice of bytes and heuristically decide if it look like program bytes
    Given a base64 encoded program bytes for heuristic sanity check "<bytes>"
    When I start heuristic sanity check over the bytes
    Then if the heuristic sanity check throws an error, the error contains "<error>"

    Examples:
      | bytes                                                                            | error                          |
      |                                                                                  | empty program                  |
      | RE43TUJNQ0w1SlEzUEZVUVM3VE1YNUFINEVFS09CSlZEVUY0VENWNldFUkFUS0ZMUUY0TVFVUFpUQQ== | get Algorand address           |
      | U0dPMUdLU3p5RTdJRVBJdFR4Q0J5dzl4OEZtbnJDRGV4aTkvY09VSk9pST0=                     | should not be b64 encoded      |
      | Q2FzdCBhIGNvbGQgZXllCm9uIGxpZmUsIG9uIGRlYXRoLgpIb3JzZW1hbiwgcGFzcyBieQ==         | all ASCII printable characters |
      | ASABASI=                                                                         |                                |
scenario.title: Read a slice of bytes and heuristically decide if it look like program bytes
